title: IP Allowlist Blocks Legitimate Office Traffic After Office Relocation
alternate_search_terms: blocked from stack after office move
team locked out after office relocation

extracted_facts.problem: After the customer's office relocated, their team was suddenly blocked from accessing the stack with an IP-restriction error.
extracted_facts.root_cause: The stack's IP allowlist still referenced the old office's static IP range.
resolution_steps: Add the new office's IP range to the stack's IP allowlist under Security settings.

hallucinations.claim: even though credentials and permissions are unchanged
hallucinations.problem: The source case never mentions credentials or permissions status at all — this is an added detail not stated or directly entailed by the case.

revision_notes: Remove or rephrase 'even though credentials and permissions are unchanged' in the summary — the source case does not state or imply anything about credential/permission status.

verification_history.revision_summary: Removed the unsupported claim about credentials/permissions being unchanged from the problem statement, as the source case never mentions credential or permission status.
